title: HostCover Plan Coverage Discount on Host Accounts Service Fees
content:
# Host Fees Policy — HostCover Discount on a Re-Rated Percentage (Host Accounts)

**Rule.** When a Host Accounts holder's host service fee is re-rated, a HostCover discount comes off the re-rated percentage according to the host's active Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plans:

- **0.15** percentage points when the account's active HostCover plans at HostCover Plus, HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite or HostCover Estate number at least its listed and snoozed listings;
- **0.05** percentage points when they number fewer but, counted together with its active HostCover Standard plans, at least its listed and snoozed listings;
- none otherwise.

The discount comes off the percentage the re-rating starts from, once, and is taken off before the re-rated fee is worked out.

## Truth table (hypothetical account with 12 listed and snoozed listings)

| Active plans at Plus, Premier, Elite or Estate | Active HostCover Standard plans | Other plans | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0 | 0 | 0.15 points |
| 9 | 3 | 0 | 0.05 points |
| 9 | 2 | 1 HostCover Essential | None |
| 13 | 0 | 0 | 0.15 points |

Only active plans count: a cancelled, lapsed or pending-activation plan adds nothing. HostCover Essential plans count toward neither figure.
